correctness.rationale: The exact finite input consists of 120 total orders and 30 canonical ternary queries. Two enumeration methods and two evaluation predicates agree on all 60 distinct concept rows. Exhaustive projection of every support of size at most 5 produces all coefficients, excludes all 142506 size-5 supports, and by downward closure all larger supports. Facets and 25 disjoint permutation orbits are independently reconstructed and re-expanded; sixteen explicit orders witness all patterns for a four-query support.

originality.rationale: Directly relevant full-text order-betweenness literature concerns definability and axiomatization, while permutation VC literature addresses a different projection predicate. No exact five-label face polynomial, nonpure facet partition or 25-orbit census was identified in actual indexed searches and accessible primary sources. Older alternative terminology and some inaccessible full texts remain a concrete risk; this is not a uniqueness proof.

Search-based absence cannot establish global priority.

value.rationale: The complete five-point Boolean shattering complex of a canonical ternary order predicate is a natural finite invariant: it is not captured by its VC dimension alone. There are exactly 1530 inclusion-maximal triples, 510 maximal quadruples and 25 symmetry orbits, establishing nonpurity and providing complete reproducible benchmarks for classification of ternary betweenness constraints. No inflated large-n theorem is claimed.
